groups.problem: Storage failure paths in Create (line 45) and Update (line 129) call recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration.
groups.rationale: The same copy-pasted mistake appears in both Create and Update error paths. Changing the helper call at each site fixes it, and S19 reports both sites.

groups.problem: The legacy DeleteCollection goroutine records its timing with recordStorageDuration instead of recordLegacyDuration (line 166).
groups.rationale: All of these point at line 166 and give the same fix.

groups.problem: The Delete success-path metric passes the object name instead of options.Kind as the kind label (line 106).
groups.rationale: Same line, same wrong argument, same fix.

groups.problem: The async legacy-write goroutines derive their context from the request-scoped ctx, so the legacy write can be cancelled when the request ends.
groups.rationale: Both point at the context.WithTimeoutCause(ctx, ...) in the goroutines and propose detaching it with context.WithoutCancel.
